newsitem.title: THAILAND: Reference rate weakens to 31.980 - Bank of Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Reference rate weakens to 31.980 - Bank of Thailand.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand on Tuesday said the weighted average interbank exchange rate was 31.980 per dollar against 31.657 on Monday.
The reference rate is the average rate traded the previous day. It has been announced daily by the central bank since the July 2 managed flotation of the baht.
The baht was quoted at 32.40/32.57 to the dollar onshore and 32.70/32.80 in offshore markets early.
